Rain Sticking deadbolts

Every November, the bolt misses the plate.

  1. 1

    October. The bolt slides straight into the strike plate.

  2. 2

    November. Rain swells the door, it drops a few millimetres and the bolt hits the frame.

  3. 3

    We move the plate. Strike moved and door adjusted so the bolt throws in the wet months too.

What neighbours wrote after we left.

4.8 average across 96 reviews Sample rating

  • Lakewood5 of 5

    We got PCS orders and closed on a house in Lakewood two days before the truck came. They rekeyed six locks the morning we got the keys, so the movers only ever had our new ones.

    Keisha R. · Move-in rekeys Sample review

  • Tacoma5 of 5

    Every November our front deadbolt stops lining up. He moved the strike plate, planed a sliver off the door and showed me why it happens. Locks easily now, even after a week of rain.

    Doug H. · Sticking deadbolts Sample review

  • Tacoma5 of 5

    Our Stadium District house still has the original glass knobs. Another company wanted to replace everything. Many Doors fixed the old latches and kept the look.

    Claire V. · Old house hardware Sample review

  • Puyallup4 of 5

    Three rentals in Puyallup and Fife. Turnovers get rekeyed fast, the keys come back tagged, and the price is the same range every time. That makes my life simpler.

    Raj P. · Rental turnovers Sample review

  • University Place5 of 5

    Locked out in the rain with the baby asleep inside. They told me the price range, texted the tech's name and van, and checked my ID before opening. Fifteen calm minutes on the porch.

    Jenna L. · Locked out of the house Sample review

  • Steilacoom5 of 5

    Keys locked in the car at the Steilacoom ferry lot. Opened it without a scratch and was gone before my coffee got cold.
